title: 每 N 轮生成预览

standard.summary: 每训练 N 个 epoch 生成一次预览图。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Generates a preview image every N training epochs.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每训练 N 个 epoch 生成一次预览图。留空则仅在 epoch 结束时按默认频率生成

advanced_en.principle: Generates preview images every N training epochs. When empty, previews are generated at the default frequency at epoch end.
